name: artifact-empty-inline-runtime-target-preserved
description: Preserves an empty inline DOM target nested inside text when first-party script mutates it at runtime.

source_reference.notes: Generic regression coverage for dynamic status/loading spans whose initial text is intentionally empty.

legacy_comparison.reason: Runtime dependency parity is an upstream artifact compiler contract with no legacy comparison.

files.content: const dots = document.getElementById('sync-dots'); dots.textContent = '...'; document.getElementById('status-text').addEventListener('click', function () { dots.textContent = ''; });
